title: Improve file change detection in gemini-review.yml workflow
description: The workflow uses git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD to identify changed files. This only covers the last commit. If a push contains multiple commits, changes in earlier commits of the push will be missed. It should be updated to use github.event.before and github.event.after or compare against the dev branch more robustly.

title: Hardcoded path in gemini-review.yml workflow
description: The Gemini Code Review workflow uses a hardcoded path /home/dagmod/DAGMod in the Run Gemini Review step. This makes the workflow non-portable and dependent on the specific directory structure of the self-hosted runner. It should be replaced with ${{ github.workspace }}.

title: Fragile hardcoded PATH in Gemini Review workflow
description: The Gemini Review workflow has a hardcoded PATH environment variable. This is fragile and may break if the self-hosted runner environment changes. It should ideally use the runner's default path or dynamically locate the required binaries.

title: Redundant git pull in gemini-review.yml workflow
description: The Gemini Code Review workflow runs git pull origin dev inside the Run Gemini Review step. Since actions/checkout@v4 is already called at the start of the job, this is redundant and could potentially lead to conflicts or unexpected states if the runner environment is not clean.
